plans.starterDesc: 15 songs/month, YouTube upload, AI cover art
plans.agencyDesc: 80 songs/month, YouTube upload, 10 avatar videos, Facebook posting

landing.badge: 5 free songs on signup · No credit card needed
landing.heroSub: No studio. No producer. No experience needed. Just type your idea and {{brand}} turns it into a full original song — lyrics, vocals, cover art and all.
landing.featuresSub: From brief to published track in minutes — {{brand}} handles lyrics, audio, cover art, and distribution.
landing.step1Desc: Describe your track in plain English. "A sad R&B song about moving on" or "Hard grime bars about making it" — that's all you need.
landing.step2Desc: AI writes the lyrics, produces the track, generates animated cover art. Done in under 2 minutes.
landing.step3Desc: Upload to YouTube in one click. Share to Facebook, Telegram. Your music, live instantly.
landing.pricingTitle: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready.
landing.pricingSub: No credit card needed. 5 free songs when you sign up.
landing.starterDesc: For artists getting started with AI music creation.
landing.proDesc: For active creators who want avatar videos.
landing.agencyDesc: For prolific creators and label teams.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to make your first song?
landing.ctaSub: Join thousands of creators making original music with AI.

songGenerator.title: AI Song Generator
songGenerator.desc: Turn a text brief into a full original song — lyrics by Claude AI, audio by Suno. Full lyrics and vocals in 60 seconds.

genres.title: 90+ Genres
genres.desc: Grime, Afrobeats, Reggaeton, Latin Trap, Bhangra, Metal, Rockney, D&B, Jungle, Drill, Amapiano, UK Garage, Lo-Fi, Reggae, Bassline and 80+ more.

coverArt.title: Cinematic Cover Art
coverArt.desc: Every cover gets a smooth Ken Burns cinematic motion effect — free for all users. Upgrade to HD Video Animation powered by Kling AI for true video covers.

avatarVideos.title: Avatar Lip-Sync Videos
avatarVideos.desc: AI performer sings your track in HD video. Perfect for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and music promotion.

genreBlending.title: Genre Blending
genreBlending.desc: Combine two genres for a unique hybrid sound — Grime-Trap, Afro-Soul, or any mix you imagine. DJ-style genre switching included.

djMixer.title: DJ Mixer
djMixer.desc: Mix your songs together and record your set — a built-in DJ deck for blending your AI tracks.

voiceToText.title: Voice to Text
voiceToText.desc: Describe your song by speaking, not typing. Hit the mic and Zeus transcribes your idea instantly.

templates.title: Song Templates
templates.desc: One-click starters: Club Banger, Emotional R&B, Grime Bars and more — skip the blank page.

stemSeparator.title: Stem Separator
stemSeparator.desc: Split any song into vocals, drums, bass and instrumental separately. Download each track individually.

youtube.title: YouTube Upload
youtube.desc: One click — song goes live on your channel. Zeus uploads the audio, sets the title, and handles everything.

facebookInstagram.title: Facebook & Instagram
facebookInstagram.desc: Post to Facebook or share to Instagram directly from Zeus Beats — caption written, image included, no switching apps.

discoverFeed.title: Discover Feed
discoverFeed.desc: Browse and listen to songs from Zeus Beats users worldwide — a public music community built in to the app.

playlist.title: Playlist & Auto-play
playlist.desc: Build playlists from your library and let them run on auto-play — curate your set and let Zeus Beats handle the queue.

musicSearch.title: Music Search
musicSearch.desc: Find any artist, copy their style, generate your version — search for inspiration and make it your own.

modelSelector.title: Model Selector
modelSelector.desc: Choose your Suno model — V4, V5, or V5.5 for the latest sound quality and features.

vocalGender.title: Vocal Gender
vocalGender.desc: Male, Female, or Duet — control who sings your track.

accents.title: 27+ Accents
accents.desc: Punjabi, Jamaican, Grime MC, West African, Colombian, Puerto Rican, British, American Hip-Hop, Irish, Scottish and more.

explicit.title: Explicit Toggle
explicit.desc: Enable explicit content for grime, drill, and street genres — authentic language where it fits.

weirdness.title: Weirdness Control
weirdness.desc: Slide from Safe to Experimental — control how conventional or boundary-pushing your track sounds.

avoidTags.title: Avoid Tags
avoidTags.desc: Tell Zeus what NOT to include — no piano, no trumpet, no slow sections. You're in control.

inspiredBy.title: Inspired by Artist
inspiredBy.desc: Type any artist name for style inspiration — Zeus captures the vibe without copying the sound.

artistName.title: Artist Name
artistName.desc: Set your stage name — it's shown on all your songs and videos automatically.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.desc: Star and save your best songs. Find your hits instantly without scrolling through everything.

songFilters.title: Song Filters
songFilters.desc: All Songs, Favourites, Recent — find exactly what you need in seconds.

multiLanguage.title: Multi-language
multiLanguage.desc: 13 languages including French, Spanish, German, Japanese, Chinese and Arabic — Zeus Beats speaks your language.

cookies.message: We use cookies to improve your experience. By using Zeus Beats you agree to our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
